$studentId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['electionId', 'studentId', 'room', 'candidate', 'time']) && newData.child('electionId').val() === $electionId && newData.child('studentId').val() === $studentId && newData.child('room').isString() && newData.child('candidate').isString() && newData.child('time').isNumber()
